facts.business: Lesha Industries Limited engages in trading activities including purchase and sale of goods with related parties such as Rhetan TMT Limited, and provides services to Ashnisha Industries Limited.
key_risks: Significant related party transactions with entities where KMP/Directors exercise significant influence
Concentration of transactions with Rhetan TMT Limited and Ashnisha Industries Limited
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions approved for up to Rs. 150 crore with Rhetan TMT Limited for FY 2027-28. Transactions include purchase/sale of goods, services, loans and advances with Rhetan TMT Limited, Ashnisha Industries Limited, Gujarat Natural Resources Limited, Ashoka Metcast Limited, Lesha Ventures Private Limited, and KMPs. Key transactions in FY 2025-26: Sales to Rhetan TMT Limited Rs. 547.48 lakh, Sale of services to Ashnisha Industries Limited Rs. 12.00 lakh, Loan granted to Ashnisha Industries Limited Rs. 2.70 lakh, Loan repaid by Shalin A Shah Rs. 27.50 lakh, Loan repaid to Lesha Ventures Private Limited Rs. 0.36 lakh.
